test_structure.description: DSM-5 Persistent Depressive Disorder Diagnostic Test

test_metadata.super_test_name: DSM-5 Persistent Depressive Disorder Diagnostic Test
test_metadata.display_text_before_questions: Please indicate below whether you have experienced the following over the past 2 years:

question_template.text: Have you found yourself feeling somewhat down for most of the day, day after day, for at least the past two years ?

question_template.description_for_subsequent_question: When in a depressed mood have you experienced following:
When in a depressed mood have you experienced following:
question_template.text: Insomnia or hyper-somnia (that is over sleeping) ?

question_template.description_for_subsequent_question: When in a depressed mood have you experienced following:
When in a depressed mood have you experienced following:
When in a depressed mood have you experienced following:
question_template.text: Poor concentration or difficulty making decisions ?

question_template.description_for_subsequent_question: When in a depressed mood have you experienced following:

question_template.text: During the period of at least 2 years that you were feeling down, you reported that you (if Q2>0) had a poor appetite or were were overeating, (if Q3>0) experienced insomnia or hypersomnia, (if Q4>0) experienced low energy or fatigue, (if Q5>0) low self esteem, (if Q6>0) poor concentration or difficulty making decisions if Q7>0 and feelings of hopelessness. During the 2 years of feeling depressed was there a period of 2 months or more when you did not experience any of these symptoms?
Did the symptoms cause you significant distress or impairment areas of functioning ?

question_display_logic.description: Array of objects defining when questions should be displayed

logic_template.exit_action: skip que 8 and move to next question

implementation_notes: for que 8 (summary kind of question) - For questions 2 to 7, only display the symptoms where the user's answer is greater than 0.
for displaying question 8 both the conditions need to be fulfill
